description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magalla, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad Map No. 810012 (24/0558)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
